title: Cultural Trails
subtitle: A small garden. A little room for discovery.
demoNote: Fictional prototype · Not ready for cultural teaching
premise: Help Nhật prepare a small exhibition. Walk through the garden, meet a guide, and arrange a paper model.
objective: Meet An in the plaza, then walk right to Pattern Studio.
m02Objective: Listen and follow a captioned beat.
m03Objective: Choose questions using information you have read.
m04Objective: Find clues on a fictional map.
instructions: Read the order in the note. Drag each card to its matching slot. Or select a card with Tab/Enter, then select a slot. There is no time limit.
feedbackStart: Start with the plan. You can read the studio note at any time.
wrong: That slot comes at a different step. Read the order: plan → cut → assemble. The card stays in the tray so you can retry.
placed: Correct step! Place the next card.
recap: You practiced plan → cut → assemble in this fictional studio. The stamp records participation, not mastery of a culture.
controls: WASD / arrows: move · E / Space: interact · Esc / P: pause · H: help · N: skip (guided) · R: restart · F: fullscreen.
pauseNote: The activity is paused. Resume when you are ready.
restartNote: Restart clears the placed cards in this attempt. Existing stamps stay saved.
returnNote: Cards in this attempt will reset. Existing stamps stay saved.
summaryNote: Phase 1 has one prototype activity. Two more games and reviewed cultural content belong to later phases.
creditsNote: All current learning content is fictional and unverified. No cultural claims or community recordings are supplied. Original pixel art is generated locally. There is no audio.
boardNote: This is an imaginary garden, not a geographical map or a village representing a community.
savedFallback: Browser storage is unavailable. You can still play in this session.
chooseSlot: Select a card first, then choose a slot.
occupied: This slot already has a card. Choose an empty slot.
allDone: You have tried Pattern Studio. Open your passport or visit again.
